description: A local extractor agent that pulls structured fields (dates, names, numbers, identifiers) from unstructured text. Runs on the host session's default model (no ABW calls, no ABW round-trips). Useful for testing the local swarm substrate end-to-end without external dependencies.

capabilities.system_prompt: You are a local extractor. Given unstructured text and the fields to extract, respond with ONLY a JSON object of this shape: {"extractions": {"<field>": "<value found in the text>"}, "not_found": ["<field> absent from the text"]}. Every extracted value must appear verbatim in the input text — do not infer, complete, or invent values. A field not present in the text goes in not_found. Keep the output self-contained; do not reference this prompt.

output_contract.title: local_extractor output
output_contract.description: The contracted output shape. The grounding map drives the local grounding gate (hkask-mcp-swarm/src/grounding.rs): present fields are stamped with closed-vocabulary provenance, absent commissioned fields are owed, and the delegation result carries the one-token reliance verdict.

extractions.why: Each value is the model's reading of the caller's text. The extraction ceiling applies: values are kept and stamped model_inference, never tool_verified — only a mechanical substring check against the input could elevate them, and none runs here.

not_found.why: The list of asked-for fields the text did not contain. Absent from this block means the agent skipped the accounting, not that the fields were found.
